meta.name: ponytail-gain
meta.description: Show ponytail's measured impact as a compact scoreboard: less code, less cost, more speed, from the benchmark medians. One-shot display, not a persistent mode, and not a per-repo number. Trigger: /ponytail-gain, "ponytail gain", "what does ponytail save", "show ponytail impact", "ponytail scoreboard".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 一眼看穿 ponytail 的代码瘦身、降本、提速效果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你使用 ponytail 并想直观看到它的量化收益。
copy.tagline_en: See ponytail's measured impact on code size, cost, and speed at a glance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use ponytail and want to see its quantified benefits.

howto.what: 当被要求时，Claude会显示一个ASCII记分牌，列出基准中位数：代码行数为无技能的6–20%（减少80–94%），成本为23–53%（减少47–77%），速度为3–6倍。该显示不修改任何文件，也不进入持久模式。
howto.when: 当你说“/ponytail-gain”、“ponytail gain”、“what does ponytail save”等触发词时触发。
howto.what_en: When invoked, Claude displays a compact ASCII scoreboard with benchmark medians: code lines at 6–20% of no-skill (80–94% less), cost at 23–53% (47–77% less), speed 3–6× faster. It does not edit files or persist mode.
howto.when_en: Triggered by saying "/ponytail-gain", "ponytail gain", "what does ponytail save", etc.

say_en.note: Matches the "what does ponytail save" entry.
